verses.translation: A Psalm of David. The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

translations.ron: Zis-a Domnul Domnului Meu: "Şezi de-a dreapta Mea, până ce voi pune pe vrăjmaşii Tăi aşternut picioarelor Tale".
translations.grk: Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυίδ. Εἶπεν ὁ Κύριος τῷ Κυρίῳ μου, κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου, ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου.

verses.translation: The Lord shall send out a rod of power for thee out of Sion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

translations.ron: Toiagul puterii Tale ţi-l va trimite Domnul din Sion, zicând: "Stăpâneşte în mijlocul vrăjmaşilor Tăi.
translations.grk: Ῥάβδον δυνάμεως ἐξαποστελεῖ σοι Κύριος ἐκ Σιὼν, κατακυρίευε ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου.

verses.translation: With thee is dominion in the day of thy power, in the splendours of thy saints: I have begotten thee from the womb before the morning.

translations.ron: Cu Tine este poporul Tău în ziua puterii Tale, întru strălucirile sfinţilor Tăi. Din pântece mai înainte de luceafăr Te-am născut".
translations.grk: Μετὰ σοῦ ἡ ἀρχὴ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τῆς δυνάμεώς σου, ἐν ταῖς λαμπρότησι τῶν ἁγίων σου· ἐκ γαστρὸς πρὸ Ἑωσφόρου ἐγέννησά σε.

verses.translation: The Lord sware, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever, after the order of Melchisedec.

translations.ron: Juratu-S-a Domnul şi nu-I va părea rău: "Tu eşti preot în veac, după rânduiala lui Melchisedec".
translations.grk: Ὤμοσε Κύριος καὶ οὐ μεταμεληθήσεται, σὺ ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισεδέκ.

verses.translation: The Lord at thy right hand has dashed in pieces kings in the day of his wrath.

translations.ron: Domnul este de-a dreapta Ta; sfărâmat-a în ziua mâniei Sale împăraţi.
translations.grk: Κύριος ἐκ δεξιῶν σου συνέθλασεν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ βασιλεῖς.

verses.translation: He shall judge among the nations, he shall fill up the number of corpses, he shall crush the heads of many on the earth.

translations.ron: Judeca-va între neamuri; va umple totul de ruini; va zdrobi capetele multora pe pământ.
translations.grk: Κρινεῖ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσι, πληρώσει πτώματα, συνθλάσει κεφαλὰς ἐπὶ γῆν πολλῶν.

verses.translation: He shall drink of the brook in the way; therefore shall he lift up the head.

translations.ron: Din pârâu pe cale va bea; pentru aceasta va înălţa capul.
translations.grk: Ἐκ χειμάῤῥου ἐν ὁδῷ πίεται, διὰ τοῦτο ὑψώσει κεφαλήν.
